model.name: Qwen2.5-0.5B
model.pairing: pair i rotates coordinates i and i + 32 (rotate_half)
model.positions: RoPE on queries and keys, pairs (i, i + 32)

examples.title: Repeated sentence
examples.prompt: The cat sat on the mat. The cat sat on the mat.

examples.title: Repeated phrase
examples.prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The quick brown

examples.title: Two names
examples.prompt: When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to

capture.q: q_proj output rotated by the model’s cos and sin (apply_rotary_pos_emb)
capture.kRaw: k_proj output before RoPE; one row per key/value head
capture.out: output of o_proj, before the residual add
capture.groups: query head h reads key/value head floor(h / 7) (repeat_kv)
capture.shiftRun: the same prompt with position_ids = 0 … T − 1 plus the shift; the causal mask is unchanged

book.source: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (1892), Project Gutenberg eBook #1661, public domain
book.cut: the text between the Project Gutenberg START and END markers, stripped
book.start: To Sherlock Holmes she is always
book.opening:
To Sherlock Holmes she is always _the_ woman. I have seldom heard him
mention her under any other name.

capture.decay: mean of q·k/√64 over all query–key pairs (i, j), j ≥ 1, with i − j in each bin; raw uses the q_proj and k_proj outputs unrotated, a counterfactual

extras.cos: [T, 32] cos(position · θ_i) as the model computes it (both halves are equal)
extras.layer.*.qRaw: [H, T, d] queries before RoPE (q_proj output)
extras.layer.*.kRaw: [Hk, T, d] keys before RoPE (k_proj output)
extras.shift.layer.*.q: [H, T, d] queries of the run with positions + 10000, after RoPE
extras.shift.layer.*.k: [Hk, T, d] keys of the run with positions + 10000, after RoPE
extras.shift.layer.*.scores: [H, T, T] scores of the run with positions + 10000
extras.decay.edges: [B + 1] distance bin edges; bin b holds distances edges[b] ≤ i − j < edges[b + 1]
extras.decay.count: [B] query–key pairs per bin in the 4,096-token book passage (key 0 left out)
extras.layer.*.decay.rope: [H, B] mean q·k/√64 per distance bin over the book passage, rotated
extras.layer.*.decay.raw: [H, B] the same with q_proj and k_proj unrotated (counterfactual)
